messages:
emma.docs: Heads up — noticed a weird jump in anchors on the staging doc for the SDK snippets after merging #2345. Clicking the heading in the TOC jumps to the top of the page instead of the section. lia-engineering: ugh, saw that too. I think it started after someone pasted an inline
in the MDX. nate-platform: probable culprit: MDX inline HTML can break slug generation if not wrapped. Can you paste the snippet? emma.docs: here: ``` 
client.generate({ model: 'redwood-mini', prompt })
``` sam-ux: iirc Docusaurus slugify runs on the rendered AST; raw HTML nodes don't produce headings, so the anchor index shifts. docs-bot: Build log for PR #2345: docusaurus build — 1 warning, 0 errors. Anchor mismatch detected: page "sdk/getting-started" line ~134. lia-engineering: quick test: if you replace the
with a fenced code block it works. so need to either convert to proper MDX or add explicit id on the heading. emma.docs: repro steps: 1) checkout pr branch 2) yarn && yarn build:docs 3) open /sdk/getting-started#instantiation -> jumps to top nate-platform: possible fixes: - wrap the HTML in MDX fragment with a proper heading before it - add explicit heading id like `### Instantiation {#instantiation}` - run slugger plugin to normalize after HTML nodes sam-ux: i'd prefer the explicit id for now so we can ship. can someone push a tiny patch? lia-engineering: i'll open a quick follow-up pr to replace the inline HTML with a normal code fence and add the explicit id. assigning to myself. emma.docs: awesome. can we also add a CI check to catch toc->anchor mismatches? maybe run linkcheck against fragments in the build step. nate-platform: we already run mkdocs-linkcheck for docs teams, but Docusaurus needs a fragment test. i'll add a linter job: `yarn docs:check-fragments` that parses the generated HTML for missing ids referenced by fragments. lia-engineering: created PR #2350 with the replacement and heuristic test. avoids changing layout. emma.docs: tested on staging — anchors behave now. thanks! tagging for backport to v1-docs branch? sam-ux: yes please, customer-facing content on v1 needs it. lia-engineering: backport PR #2351 opened. small changelog entry added. docs-bot: Auto-deploy started for staging docs after merge of #2350. emma.docs: closing the thread — will monitor for any other anchor oddities. :thumbsup:
